Solana Foundation Takes Majority Stake in CoinGecko

Solana Foundation member Vibhu confirmed that the foundation now holds a majority interest in CoinGecko, the crypto data platform. CoinGecko plans to expand its data and API infrastructure, enhance coverage of on-chain assets, RWAs and derivatives, and explore trading and DeFi services powered by Solana. CoinGecko said it will maintain its cross-chain coverage and transparent methodology. The exact ownership percentage and transaction value were not disclosed. — link
